description: This PHP class defines a 'Prop' used in a Vue.js context within the OrangeHRM system. It manages property attributes such as name, type, and raw value, providing constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Prop
classes.description: Represents a property for Vue components with attributes for name, type, and raw value, including methods for accessing and modifying these attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes a Prop with specified name, type, and value.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the property.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the property.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value of the property.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets the raw value of the property.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON-encoded string representation of the raw value.
